intro_caption: The Volunteers module in Sahana Eden supports end-to-end volunteer management - from registration, through skills and training, to mobilization during emergencies.
config_intro: We start by configuring the base catalogs that will be used when registering volunteers.
section_skills: Skills catalog - this is where we define the competencies volunteers can have.
create_skill: We create a new skill that will be available during volunteer registration.
skill_created: The skill has been created and is available in the catalog.
section_roles: Volunteer roles catalog - we define the positions and functions volunteers can perform.
create_role: We create a new volunteer role.
role_created: The role has been created and is available in the system.
section_certificates: Certificates catalog - we register all certificate and qualification types.
create_certificate: We create a new certificate type.
certificate_created: The certificate has been added to the catalog.
section_courses: Training courses catalog - we define all available trainings.
create_course: We create a new training course.
course_created: The course has been added to the training catalog.
volunteer_intro: Now we can register a new volunteer using the catalogs we created earlier.
create_volunteer: We register a new volunteer - filling in a full form with personal, contact, and competency details.
volunteer_cluster_type: Volunteer group type defines the kind or category of group the volunteer may belong to. This field mainly helps organize and filter volunteer group lists
volunteer_program: Volunteer program - we choose the program the volunteer will participate in
volunteer_role: Volunteer role - we choose a position from the role catalog created earlier
volunteer_created: The volunteer has been registered in the system and is visible in the list.
team_intro: Volunteers can be organized into teams for better coordination of activities.
section_teams: Team list - volunteer groups assigned to specific tasks or areas.
create_team: We create a new volunteer team.
team_created: The team has been created and is ready for action.
training_intro: The system supports organizing trainings and tracking volunteer participation.
section_training_events: Training events - list of planned and completed trainings.
create_training_event: We organize a new training event.
training_course: Course - we choose from the training catalog
training_participants: Participants - we assign volunteers to the training
training_created: The training event has been created.
program_intro: Volunteer programs support long-term activities and tracking work time.
section_programs: Volunteer program list - long-term initiatives and projects.
create_program: We create a new volunteer program.
program_created: The program has been created and volunteer hours can be recorded.
program_hours_intro: We record volunteer work hours within the program.
search_intro: The system offers advanced volunteer search by different criteria.
search_by_skills: Search by skills - we find volunteers with specific competencies.
search_skill_select: We choose the skill we are looking for
search_results: Search results - volunteers who match the criteria.
filter_intro: Different filters can be applied on the volunteer list.
filter_by_status: Filter by status - for example, only active volunteers
filter_by_location: Filter by location - volunteers from a specific area
filter_results: Filtered list of volunteers ready for mobilization.
reports_intro: The module offers comprehensive reports for analyzing volunteer activities.
section_reports: Reports - different summaries and analyses of volunteer data.
report_volunteer: Volunteer report - detailed summary of all registered people.
report_volunteer_desc: Includes personal data, skills, availability, and activity history for each volunteer.
report_hours_by_role: Hours by role report - analysis of work time by position.
report_hours_by_role_desc: Shows how many hours were worked in each role, useful for resource planning.
report_hours_by_program: Hours by program report - analysis of work time by program.
report_hours_by_program_desc: Shows volunteer engagement across programs and projects.
report_training: Training report - summary of all completed trainings and participants.
report_training_desc: Includes information about courses, dates, participants, and issued certificates.
report_export: Reports can be exported to CSV or PDF files for further analysis.
scenario_mobilization: Practical scenario: rapid volunteer mobilization during an emergency.
mobilization_step1: We receive a report of an urgent incident requiring assistance.
mobilization_step2: We search for volunteers with the right skills and availability.
mobilization_step3: We filter by location to find people closest to the incident.
mobilization_step4: The system shows a list of volunteers ready for immediate action.
mobilization_step5: We can send notifications to selected people through the Messaging module.
summary: The Volunteers module provides a comprehensive tool for managing volunteers - from registration, through trainings and programs, to rapid mobilization during emergencies.
summary_features: Key features: configuration catalogs, full volunteer registration, teams, trainings, programs, advanced search, and detailed reports.
summary_integration: The module integrates with other parts of Eden: Organizations, Scenarios & Events, and Messaging - creating a coherent emergency management ecosystem.
